findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 18 in the same format as the Physics 11 chapter practice (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 24 questions numbered 1-24; by section: 18.1 2, 18.2 4, 18.3 4, 18.4 4, 18.5 2, 18.6 2, 18.7 4, 18.8 2.

12 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering quantum theory and photon momentum, the photoelectric experiment, Einstein's photoelectric equation, the Compton shift, pair production and annihilation, de Broglie waves, the Davisson-Germer experiment, wave-particle duality, the electron microscope, atomic spectra, absorption and emission spectra, and the uncertainty principle. Numericals use new values, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: phi = hf0 (Eq. 18.6), (h/lambda') cos theta, Compton shift numbered Eq. 18.8, lambda = h/p (Eq. 18.10), 1/lambda in the Rydberg formulas and the Lyman series ending on n = 1, momentum in kg m s^-1, Eq. 18.16 as Delta E.Delta t ~ hbar, the anode labelled A.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
